integrity_notes: The exact global convergence proof and asymptotic derivation are supplied. Symbolic formulas and numerical trajectories were replayed; independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic mean-field two-contagion model with symmetric initial conditions only.
Exactly \(\tau=\gamma\) and \(\alpha=2\gamma_2/\gamma\), with positive recovery rates.
Does not prove nonsymmetric, stochastic, network, or off-boundary dynamics.
Physical-time limits require a nonzero initial state; no uniform rate across recovery ratios.
title: Global critical clearance and universal dual-contagion tails
